blocks.text: New, used, manufactured or modular homes for sale in Langley

parts.t: The mobile homes for sale in Langley on this page are resale homes listed on the MLS®. Most are manufactured homes in a park on a rented pad, single-wide or double-wide. A resale home can be a few years old or several decades old, so its age, its CSA label and the park's rules matter as much as the asking price.

Manufactured home and mobile home mean the same thing: a home built in a factory, moved to its site in one or two sections and registered in BC's Manufactured Home Registry. A modular home is also built in a factory, but to the A-277 standard, and it is set on a permanent foundation on land you own, so it is usually bought and financed like a house.

A brand-new manufactured or modular home is normally ordered through a manufacturer's dealer, or bought as a new unit that a park has already placed on a pad. I am a REALTOR®, not a dealer. I help you buy a resale home on the MLS® in Langley, or a new home that a park or builder has listed, and I check the label, the registry record, the pad rent and the park's approval rules before you remove subjects.

blocks.text: Five checks before you buy in a Langley park

items.t: The site tenancy agreement and park rules.
In a pad-rental park they are the rules you live under; the park can change its rules only once a year, with 3 full months' notice.
The pad rent and the last increase.
Increases are capped each year: 2.3% plus a proportional amount in 2026, and 2.2% plus a proportional amount in 2027.
How pad rent works
The park's consent.
The seller assigns the pad tenancy to you, which needs the landlord's written consent. The pad rent and the date of the next increase stay the same for you.
The CSA label and the registry.
A home can't be sold in BC without its original CSA label, and the sale is only effective once registered in the Manufactured Home Registry.
Financing.
A home on a rented pad is usually financed with a chattel loan, not a regular mortgage.

faq.q: Are there new mobile homes for sale in Langley?
faq.a: Sometimes. A park occasionally places a new manufactured home on a vacant pad and lists it on the MLS®, and it shows in the listings on this page while it is available. Most Langley listings are resale homes. To order a home from a factory, you deal with a manufactured-home dealer.

faq.q: What is the difference between a manufactured, mobile and modular home?
faq.a: Manufactured and mobile mean the same home: factory-built, moved in one or two sections and registered in BC's Manufactured Home Registry. A modular home is factory-built to the A-277 standard and set on a permanent foundation on land you own, so it is usually bought and financed like a house.

faq.q: Is Jared Gibbons a mobile home dealer?
faq.a: No. Jared is a REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty. He represents buyers and sellers of manufactured homes listed on the MLS® in Langley and across the Fraser Valley. He does not sell new units from a lot.

faq.q: How much is pad rent on a Langley mobile home?
faq.a: The figure that matters is the specific park's current rent in its written Manufactured Home Site Tenancy Agreement — current rent, last increase date, and what the rent includes.

faq.q: How much can pad rent go up each year?
faq.a: 2.3% + proportional amount for 2026; 2.2% + proportional amount for 2027; once every 12 months on 3 full months' notice; the proportional amount is park-specific, so ask the park for its last calculation.

faq.q: Does the park raise my pad rent when I buy?
faq.a: No. When a pad tenancy is assigned to a buyer, the pad rent stays the same and the next increase date doesn't reset. The landlord must consent in writing first (or be deemed to consent, or be ordered to), and can't charge a fee for it.

faq.q: Do I own the land in a Langley park?
faq.a: In a pad-rental park, no: you own the home (a chattel) and rent the pad.

faq.q: Which Langley mobile home parks are 55+?
faq.a: Four Brookswood-Fernridge parks are listed as 55+: Fernridge Park (20071 24 Avenue), Pineridge Estates (2270 196 Street), Deer Creek Estates (2315 198 Street) and Cedar Lane Park (2305 200 Street). Aldergrove Mobile Home Park and Cedar Springs Mobile Home Park in Salmon River have no age restriction. Rules come from recent listings, so confirm with the park.
